 Modern Two Bedroom Apartment in Marbella Centre 
 

 Completely renovated apartment with two bedrooms and one bathroom in the center of Marbella close to all the services that the city offers and less than five minutes walking to the beach so the car is not necessary for your stay.

 This magnificent apartment consists of access to the sixth floor of the building by elevator, entrance to the apartment without steps directly to the fully renovated and updated living room with extendable dining table, comfortable sofa with folding table for your comfort, 50 flat screen Smart TV ”Which can be accommodated in such a way that you can watch TV from the sofa from the dining area or from the furnished terrace. Kitchen open to the living room, fully equipped with everything you need to cook and quality appliances such as fridge, hob, dishwasher … you will find everything you need to cook in this kitchen. Access to the north facing terrace directly from the living room and furnished to enjoy your lunch or breakfast outdoors, very comfortable being next to the kitchen.

 Master bedroom with double bed, built-in wardrobe with great capacity to accommodate your belongings and with access to the second east-facing terrace. Full bathroom with shower. Second bedroom with two single beds, built-in wardrobe and access to the east-facing terrace. The second east-facing terrace is furnished with sofas to relax.

 The building is very well maintained and has access ramps for people with reduced mobility and an elevator.

 🌐 Own Wi-Fi throughout the apartment, ideal for working remotely.

 ❄ A/C throughout the apartment, in the living room and bedroom.

 📅 Check-in (from 4pm): the keys will be in a key box in our office; we will provide you with the information prior to your arrival. It is important that you tell us your estimated arrival time at least 48 hours before.

 🛌 Bed linen, a set of towels, and a beach towel per guest are included in the rental price.

 🚗 The property does not have a car park. You may park on the street or in public parking; the nearest parking is “Plaza del Mar”.
